scope: Deterministic source-linked candidate inventory spanning known strategy/trial catalogue sources.
implemented: Inventories historical trial ledger rows, paper-zoo identifiers/rules, all bounded-search technical variants, source chart-pattern definitions, options/futures/ranking module proxies, and strategy modules.
Every row has a unique family/name/version/asset/clock key, source SHA-256, parameter-sensitive variant SHA-256, status/category, and granularity label.
Committed inventory can be checked for staleness against the generating source catalogues.

tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_strategy_variant_inventory.py -q; python -m ruff check scripts/strategy_variant_inventory.py tests/test_strategy_variant_inventory.py
tests.result: 3 tests passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed; generated inventory --check passed. Source digests and variant digests now normalize CRLF to Git LF, so inventory verification is consistent across Windows and Ubuntu.

limitations: Options/futures and ranking coverage includes module proxies rather than every executable parameterized variant.
172 entries still lack an explicit asset or decision-clock value; they remain UNSPECIFIED rather than guessed.
The inventory is not wired as a complete approval registry and does not grant paper-order eligibility.
